senses.gloss:
शुम्भ् शुम्भ्, cl. 6. P. A. शुम्भति,
-ते, शुशुम्भ, शुम्भिष्यति, शुम्-
भितुम्, Ved. to shine, be brilliant; to decorate;
cl. 1. P. शुम्भति, &c., to shine; to speak; to
strike, injure, kill, (in these senses = rts. 3. शुभ्,
सुभ्, सुम्भ्): Caus. A., Ved. शुभयते, -यितुम्,
to decorate one's self, to shine; [cf. probably Gr.
κομψός.]
सुम्भ् सुम्भ् = rt. सुभ्.
शुम्भन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. shining, brilliant.

शुम्भान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. decorating, illumi-
nating, (Sāy. = शोभयत्.)

शुम्भमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. decorating, adorn-
ing; handsome, beautiful, (Sāy. = शोभमान.)
शुम्भित. See ब्रह्म-शुम्भित.

शुम्भ शुम्भ, अस्, m., N. of an Asura or
demon slain by Durgā, (he was son of Gaveṣṭhin
and grandson of Prahlāda.)
—शुम्भ-घातिनी or
शुम्भ-मर्दिनी, f. ‘Śumbha-killing,’ an epithet
of Durgā.
—शुम्भ-पुर, अम्, ई, n. f. ‘the city
of the Asura Śumbha,’ a town and district, (the
modern Sambhalpūr in the district of Gondwāna;
it is also called Eka-cakra and Hari-gṛha.)
—शुम्-
भ-बध or शुम्भ-वध, अस्, m. ‘killing of
Śumbha,’ N. of the tenth chapter of the Devī-
māhātmya of the Mārkaṇḍeya-Purāṇa.
सुम्भ सुम्भ, अस्, m., N. of a country.
सूम, अस्, m. milk; water; sky, heaven.

सूम सूम, अस्, अम्, m. n. (in Uṇādi-s. I.
144. said to be fr. rt. 4. सु or 3. सू), the sky,
heaven; milk; water.

सुम सुम, अस्, m. (probably fr. 5. सु +
4. म, see rt. 3. मा), the moon; the sky, atmo-
sphere, = नभ; (अम्), n. a flower.
सुमङ्गा सुमङ्गा, f., N. of a river.

सुमत् सु-मत्, ind. (probably fr. 5. सु, but
in some senses connected with स्व and स्वयम्),
Ved. ‘well,’ gladly, easily; naturally, of one's self, of
itself, (Sāy. = स्वयम्, Ṛg-veda I. 162, 7, Nirukta
VI. 22; see also Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 142, 7.)
—सुमज्-जानि, इस्, m., Ved. ‘born by his own
power, self-born,’ or ‘having a very pleasing wife,’
epithet of Viṣṇu, (Ṛg-veda I. 156, 2.)
—सुमद्-
अंशु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having natural height, naturally
high, (Sāy. = स्व-तः प्रांशु, Ṛg-veda I. 100,
16.)
—सुमद्-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a
beautiful carriage, (Sāy. = कल्याण-रथ, Ṛg-veda
VIII. 45, 39.)
सुमन्तु सु-मन्तु. See p. 1123, col. 1.

सुम्न सुम्न, अम्, n. (perhaps fr. 5. सु + म्न,
as नि-म्न fr. नि, cf. rt. म्ना), a hymn; joy, hap-
piness (= सुख, Naigh. III. 6); favour, protection;
sacrifice, (Ved. सुम्नया = सुम्नाय.)

सुम्नयु, उस्, उस्, उ, one who desires (another's)
happiness (Ved.); (उस्), m. a chanter of hymns.
सुम्नाय, Nom. P. सुम्नायति, &c., to sing hymns.

सुम्नायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. desiring happiness;
favouring.

सुम्नावरी, f., Ved. ‘having or imparting joy,’
epithet of Uṣas.

सुम्पलुण्ठ सुम्पलुण्ठ, अस्, m. zedoary,
Curcuma Zerumbet.

सूमय सू-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, (for सु-मय),
Ved. abounding in happiness, very successful, (Sāy.
= सु-सुख.)
